_note: Edges are derived: the site planner treats orthogonally adjacent grid cells (row±1 / col±1) as connected; a node can be taken if adjacent to the start node or an owned node. Stat values are raw (percent-type stats are x100, e.g. combatspeed 250 = 2.5%).
